'''Pnakotic Coast village''' was a village located on the [[Pnakotic Coast]] on the [[planet]] [[Savareen]]. It was home to a community of [[Savarian]] [[human]]s.<ref name="Solo TOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date Note">{{FilmDate|Solo}}</ref> the village was host to a [[Showdown on Savareen|showdown]] between the [[Cloud-Riders]] and the criminal organization [[Crimson Dawn]], who were fighting for control of a supply of refined [[coaxium]].<ref name="Solo" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Pnakotic Coast village first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] movie ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''.<ref name="Solo TOG" /> The area of Savareen where the refinery was located was identified as the Pnakotic Dunes as a nod to the works of author [[Wikipedia:H. P. Lovecraft|H. P. Lovecraft]]. The scenes were shot on the island [[Wikipedia:Fuerteventura|Fuerteventura]] with a set designed by [[Neil Lamont]] and hundreds of costumed extras. Co-writer [[Jon Kasdan]] called that the set "incredible" and said that the scenes were punishing to shoot because of the sands and the remote location, but said that if he would look away from the crew at the set and the extras away, he felt like he was actually standing in another galaxy.<ref name="Jon's Twitter">{{Twitter|JonKasdan|status/1040529511513616385|[[Jon Kasdan]]|date=2018-9-14|quote=continued|archivefile=File:Jon-Kasdan-SoloFacts-September-14-2018.png|archivedate=20181002054217|nolive=1}} {{C|post 3/4}}</ref>
